propositions: socket.getfqdn reverse DNS lookup on 127.0.0.1 consumes ~35 seconds during ThreadingHTTPServer construction in the editor loopback test fixture on macOS runners
the editor workflow server does not use or assert on the reverse-resolved server_name value, making the DNS lookup behaviorally unnecessary
HTTPServer.server_bind calls socket.getfqdn after binding, blocking the fixture setup; TCPServer.server_bind does not

a custom _LoopbackThreadingHTTPServer subclass that delegates bind to TCPServer.server_bind and derives server_name from literal bound address eliminates the reverse DNS call without changing served behavior or API contract
the fix removes the 35-second critical-path span from macOS Verify runs while preserving loopback binding, ephemeral port selection, request handling, and shutdown coverage
